artifact: Audit record, a trail's META.cbor, the payload of an audit checkpoint (a COSE_Sign1 of the profile in crates/permguard-objects/src/cose.rs, content type permguard.audit.checkpoint.v1, signed by the Host's host.operations key under its <ring>:<thumbprint> kid) and a trail's ANCHOR.cbor
authority: 1-architecture/5-architecture-server-host-audit.md#record (the fields), owner decisions of 2026-10-07 (labels, types, cardinalities); 1-architecture/5-architecture-server-host-audit.md (trails and checkpoints, retention), owner decisions of 2026-10-11 (checkpoint and anchor labels); crates/permguard-host/src/audit/record.rs (AuditRecord, TrailMeta), crates/permguard-host/src/audit/checkpoint.rs (Checkpoint, Anchor)
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range
